headline: Up to ₹1000 off flights, hotels and buses with Visa cards
description: One Visa code on EaseMyTrip: 1000 rupees off international flights (min 15000 rupees), up to 800 rupees off domestic round trips (min 3500 rupees; 400 rupees off one-way from 3000 rupees), 500 rupees off hotels (min 3500 rupees) and 120 rupees off buses (min 1200 rupees).
how_to_redeem:
1. Search flights, hotels or buses on easemytrip.com or the EaseMyTrip app
2. Enter your details and apply code EMTVISA
3. Pay with your Visa card
terms: Minimums: international flights 15000 rupees, domestic one-way 3000 / round trip 3500 rupees, hotels 3500 rupees, buses 1200 rupees; once per customer; new and existing users; convenience fee applies; not combinable with other EaseMyTrip offers; Visa cards only
verified_note: ✓ Official Visa India offer page (checked 6 Oct 2026)

headline: Flat ₹2000 off jewellery orders of ₹25,000+ with Visa cards
description: Get 2000 rupees off on gehnaindia.com when your cart is 25000 rupees or more and you pay with a Visa card. Not valid on gold coins or solitaires.
how_to_redeem:
1. Add jewellery worth 25000 rupees or more to your cart on gehnaindia.com
2. Apply code VISAG2000 at checkout
3. Pay with your Visa card
terms: Minimum cart value 25000 rupees; not on gold coins or solitaires; gehnaindia.com only; once per user; Visa cards only
verified_note: ✓ Official Visa India offer page (checked 6 Oct 2026)

headline: Free 1-year Times Prime membership for Visa Signature credit cardholders (no code)
